delivery_notes: CNS targets: systemic IV (AAV9/AAVrh.10) or direct ICV/intrathecal for hippocampal neurons.
Ameloblasts: potentially accessible via local intraoral injection (no CNS crossing needed).
Dual targeting needed: enamel + CNS is an unresolved delivery paradox for a single vector program.
overexpression_rationale: GMP reductase is a metabolic enzyme in purine metabolism; constitutive overexpression could perturb guanine nucleotide pools. Tissue-specific or weak promoter may be preferable.
cross_correction_rationale: ROGDI is intracellular (cytosolic, presynaptic). No secreted form known. Cell-autonomous rescue required in each target cell type.

standardised_gt_protocol_preview.regulatory_pathway: RMAT or IND with orphan drug designation
risk_mitigations: Use self-complementary AAV (scAAV) for faster expression in neurons
Monitor guanine nucleotide metabolites (GMP, GDP, GTP) as PD biomarker
Consider dual-promoter construct for ameloblast rescue (K14 or AMELX promoter)
Immunogenicity screen anti-AAV9 capsid and anti-ROGDI T-cell epitopes pre-dosing
